understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to complete each level by placing all selectable pieces onto the goal tiles marked with a `+`, and for levels with multiple `+` tiles, every goal had to be occupied simultaneously to trigger a WIN and progress until the full game was completed.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement was turn/step-limited per level.
